For positive integer k, atan(k+1)−atan(k) lies in(0,π/2) and has tangent1/(k²+k+1). Thus it equals the displayed summand on the principal real branch. Telescoping and atan(k)→π/2 give the answer; exact alternating bounds distinguish the revised omission choices.
The logarithm of the non-power factor is m k+k² ln(1−m/k)=−m²/2+O(1/k). Its positive finite limit gives limit comparison with k^(−p), whose exact convergence threshold is1.
Evaluate the geometric tail from its stated first index; the common ratio is1/m.
